title: Suspended Window Garden
desc: A suspended garden window: white orchids and larkspur cascading over feathery greens against a pleated white drape.

groups.label: Feature flowers
groups.blurb: The white cascade running across the suspended garden.

items.role: White phalaenopsis clusters hanging through the centre (the ruffled white cascades).
White branching larkspur spikes rising through the greens (form-match for the large white delphinium).
White ranunculus filling the mid-section clusters.
White hydrangea heads anchoring the top edge.
White oncidium orchid sprays arching out of the greenery.

groups.label: Greenery & trailing
groups.blurb: The feathery, trailing greens that build the hanging silhouette.

items.role: Asparagus fern forming the feathery body of the garden.
Fine-leaf eucalyptus sprigs through the mid layer.
Fountain grass plumes softening the edges.
Long green tassels trailing down below the blooms (form-match hanging green spike).
Dark green pine spray giving needle texture.
Pure white pleated milk-silk drape hung behind the suspended garden (wooden wall is the venue surface — logged gap).
